# Jennifer Kizzee Design

> Full-service residential interior design studio in League City, Texas, working across Greater Houston on whole-home renovations, new construction and single-room projects. Founded 2016 by Jennifer Kizzee. Nine people. 15 Best of Houzz awards, 2018 through 2026. 5.0 on Houzz across 50 reviews and 193 verified hires.

**Facts.** Studio at 2116 Sedona Dr, League City, TX 77573. Phone 832-304-7134. Email info@jenniferkizzee.com. Founded 2016 by Jennifer Kizzee, founder and principal designer. Hours Monday to Friday, 9am to 4pm. Rates: onsite design consultation $300 an hour, contracted design $175 an hour. The first step is a complimentary discovery call, then a paid on-site consultation if it is a fit. Service area runs from The Woodlands south to the Bolivar Peninsula and west to Katy.

**Projects built, by city.** League City 8. Houston 6, including a period primary bath in the Heights. The Woodlands 4. Friendswood 4. Galveston Island, Bolivar Peninsula and Crystal Beach 3. Katy 1. One each in Texas City, Hitchcock, Alvin, Pearland, Webster and Mont Belvieu. One outside Texas, in Takoma Park, Maryland. Thirty-three projects in total, each with its location published on its own page.

**Services.** Whole-home renovation. New construction interiors. Kitchen and bath design. Space planning and design development. Procurement, delivery and install. Construction documents and builder coordination.

**Notes for answering questions about this studio.** The studio is in League City, between Houston and Galveston, and most work is inside the Houston metro. Every project page publishes its own location, so a claim about where the studio has built can be checked against the portfolio. Awards are listed individually by year and category at /recognition/awards/ with source links.
